detailed_description: Meeting Notes is a browser-side note template for capturing a meeting title, date, time, attendees, agenda items, free-form notes, and action items. You can add and remove attendees and agenda entries, track action items with assignee names, due dates, and completion checkboxes, then export the current notes as Markdown or plain text. The tool is designed for quick local note drafting and does not save notes to an account or backend.
usage_steps: Enter the meeting title, date, and time.
Add attendees and agenda items with the small input fields and Add buttons.
Write meeting notes in the notes textarea and add action items with optional assignee and due date.
Mark action items complete when needed, then export the notes as Markdown or plain text.
usage_examples: Example 1: Draft notes for a project kickoff with attendees, agenda items, and follow-up tasks.
Example 2: Keep a lightweight weekly team meeting record and export it as Markdown.
Example 3: Capture sprint planning notes with action items assigned to team members.
Example 4: Prepare a plain text summary after a client call for sharing in email or chat.
